evidence.why: Six-bit PN matrix field update and helper call.
Selected register emission and exact numeric bookkeeping assignment.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported field/register flow while replacing the ambiguous claim that the bookkeeping assignment marks all GX state synchronized.
facts.value: The caller's matrix identifier replaces bits 0–5 of gx->matIdxA while preserving neighboring texture-matrix index fields. __GXSetMatrixIndex(GX_VA_PNMTXIDX) publishes the complete matIdxA word through the command-processor register selector 0x30 and XF register 24, then assigns gx->bpSent = 1. This emits matrix-selection commands; it neither uploads matrix coefficients nor waits for GPU completion.

evidence.why: Complete validation, bound packing, raster writes and zero assignment.

facts.rationale: Corrects the misleading interpretation of bpSent=0 and makes the actual assertion expressions and size edge case explicit.
facts.value: Applies the GXBegin guard and asserts left < 1708, top < 1708, left + wd < 1708, and top + ht < 1708 using unsigned arguments. It adds 342 to the origins, computes inclusive bottom/right bounds by adding dimensions and subtracting one, replaces four 11-bit fields in the scissor shadow registers, emits both raster-register words, and assigns gx->bpSent = 0. The zero assignment is bookkeeping after actual register emission, not evidence that the BP commands were unsent. No explicit nonzero-dimension check is present.

evidence.why: Normal scissor-field conversion and top-half viewport-derived rectangle.
Bottom-half scissor fields and efbHeight-8 origin.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline rationale's conflation of top-half viewport-derived bounds with CObj scissor fields, while retaining the established camera/raster mapping.
facts.value: Implements raster scissor configuration for HSD camera render regions. Normal camera setup scales the CObj scissor bounds into its framebuffer rectangle. Top-half setup instead derives a rectangle from CObj viewport bounds and caps its bottom at efbHeight. Bottom-half setup derives its rectangle from CObj scissor bounds relative to screen_top = efbHeight - 8. Each path passes origin and dimensions to GXSetScissor for raster-register installation.
